verdict.rationale: Consent capture and enforcement is a fair question for an event-collection pipeline like Jitsu, but the evidence pack never mentions consent categories, opt-out signals, or automatic downstream enforcement. The only related material is general-purpose Functions that can filter events. That is a developer building block a user would have to wire up themselves, not a consent-management capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically
